description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle and Doomed Artisan trigger.
Resolve the Doomed Artisan trigger, creating a X/X Sculpture artifact creature token.
Resolve the Teleportation Circle trigger, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Sculpture and Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
